description: The spec declares `searchFields` with `collectionFormat: csv`, but they convert to lists the protocol sends as repeated query parameters, which Azure AI Search rejects (`Found duplicate query string parameters that are not allowed: '$select'`). Model each as one comma-separated string.

patches.value: The list of field names to consider when querying for auto-completed terms. Target fields must be included in the specified suggester. Comma-separated.
